Reference / template/sections

template/sections#

Section templates over JSON, in the Mustache style.

Version: v1.0.0

Synopsis#

let order = SectionTemplate(
    source: "Order {{id}}:\n{{#items}}  - {{title}}\n{{/items}}{{^items}}  (empty)\n{{/items}}",
);
order.string(ParsedJson(text).root());

Description#

Section templates over JSON, in the Mustache style.

{{#name}}…{{/name}} repeats over an array, renders once for an object or a true value, and not at all for false, null, "", [] or a missing member; {{^name}} is the opposite; {{.}} is the current item; {{>name}} includes a template from the partials library. Nothing is escaped.

SectionTemplate is template/engine's Template in text mode (#178): the one engine compiles and renders it, its library becomes TemplatePartials, and the engine's failures come back as the errors this module always had (TemplateIterationLimitExceeded, UnsupportedTemplatePartial, MissingTemplate, TemplatePartialDepthExceeded, TemplateSectionDepthExceeded). New code uses Template directly.

object TemplateSectionOutput#

object TemplateSectionOutput

A borrowed text sink with a byte budget. It owns only its count, never the sink. Empty contributions produce no calls. No newline, flush, close or retry, and no whole-result storage. At most 1024 scalars per sink call.
